items.title: Switzerland's First Retail Bitcoin ETF Gets Regulatory Green Light
items.summary: Switzerland has approved its first retail spot bitcoin exchange-traded fund (ETF), opening a regulated investment vehicle previously unavailable to ordinary investors under Swiss fund law. Announced on Tuesday, the decision includes an exemption from standard diversification requirements, allowing a public fund to concentrate…

items.title: Premiere für Bitcoin-Anleger: Schweiz genehmigt erstmals einen echten ETF
items.summary: Mit der Zulassung eines Bitcoin ETFs schreibt die Schweiz ein Stück Finanzgeschichte. Der neue Fonds unterscheidet sich rechtlich von den ETPs, die bereits an europäischen Börsen gehandelt werden. Source: BTC-ECHO BTC-ECHO

items.title: Sam Callahan: Bitcoin Doesn't Need Rate Cuts to Succeed
items.summary: The USD lost 20% purchasing power in 5 years. Sam Callahan breaks down financial repression, core PCE spikes, and the U.S. bond market's historic drawdown. This post Sam Callahan: Bitcoin Doesn't Need Rate Cuts to Succeed first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .

items.title: Michael Howell: Bitcoin as the Apex Liquidity Asset
items.summary: CrossBorder Capital's Michael Howell explains why global liquidity drives markets and why Bitcoin is emerging as the apex asset in a debasement world. This post Michael Howell: Bitcoin as the Apex Liquidity Asset first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .

items.title: Swiss regulator FINMA approves country's first spot bitcoin ETF for retail investors
items.summary: FINMA approved Switzerland's first retail bitcoin ETF, following earlier crypto ETP listings and a fund restricted to qualified investors.

JPMorgan sees 10% annual bitcoin returns, topping stocks, bonds and gold over next decade
items.summary: The report marks the first time JPMorgan has put a range on bitcoin returns in its research, though the bank remains cautious about BTC's role in portfolios.

items.title: Mt. Gox Pushes Repayment Deadline to 2027 With $2.8B in Bitcoin Still to Distribute
items.summary: The defunct exchange's trustee said many creditors still have not completed the procedures needed to get their Bitcoin back.
